work_item: B04 stable exact-string sorting of a supplied JSON string table through Core
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: No tests or runtime/ordinary CLI verification were requested or run in this implementation slice; formatting, compilation, lint and build checks only were run.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::JsonTableSort -> ports::json_table_sort -> JsonTableSortReport artifact
input_schema: One strict JSON object with exactly columns and rows fields. columns is a unique 1..256 string array; rows is an array of at most 4096 rows, each an array of same-width strings. Duplicate JSON object keys and nonstring values are rejected.
supported_behavior: The selected named column is interpreted as a decoded string, with no numeric conversion, locale collation, case folding or Unicode normalization.
Rows are stably sorted ascending or descending; equal values retain original source order.
The report includes the output string table, original zero-based row indices, exact source ranges and digests for each output cell and column, plus the source document digest.
Input bytes, table cells, report evidence and the Core request output budget are bounded; invalid shape, absent columns or limit overflow suspend with typed failures.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; source implementation and format/check/lint/build evidence only, no test or ordinary-route execution
